action.action-desc: Mr. Blumenauer (for himself and Mr. Fitzpatrick) introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Small Business

form.official-title: To amend the American Rescue Plan Act of 2021 to increase appropriations to the Restaurant Revitalization Fund, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Restaurant Revitalization Fund Replenishment Act of 2021.

section.header: Appropriations for the Restaurant Revitalization Fund
section.text: Section 5003(b)(2) of the American Rescue Plan Act of 2021 (Public Law 117–2; 135 Stat. 85; 15 U.S.C. 9009c(b)(2)) is amended—

subparagraph.text: by inserting , of which $300,000,000 shall be for administrative expenses to carry out this section before the period at the end; and

paragraph.text: in subparagraph (B)(i)(II), by striking $23,600,000,000 and inserting $83,300,000,000.
